summary: Issue #630: a played card is now shown face-up in the middle of the table with a caption (the event text) for a beat, then travels to its owner's discard pile; a card that stays in play (an ability on the table) is shown and fades. Driven by the public strategyPlayed/abilityUsed events; opponent's plays only by default; queued; the practice opponent waits while one is showing; reduced motion gets a plain fade. All timings/sizes/switches are constants in CardPlayTiming (Main.CardPlays.cs). The older quick discard flight skips a card the showcase handles.
validation: Client project builds with 0 warnings/errors; check_format and lint_comment_swallow clean. NOT verified: no native visual or motion check, no screenshot, no Godot capture probe; timings and placement are untested guesses for Mendon/Alfredo to tune in play.
remaining: Native playtest and tuning of the look/timing; the discard pile's count updates immediately when the view arrives, so the pile can show the card before the showcase finishes.
